_note: Measurement register. Every value lists each reading, the photo, the reference used and the method. Photos are third-party and are linked, not stored. See docs/METHOD.md.

mat_grid.what: A3 self-healing cutting mat, 1 cm printed grid, 0-42 x 0-27 cm rulers, labelled circles 10-29 mm
mat_grid.status: printed scale; homography residual 0.16-0.39 mm RMS over 351-631 grid crossings

hose_6mm.what: Hasbro stock red and blue hoses, 6 mm

readings.method: focal minimising circle-fit residual of the cake rim

cake_top_diameter_mm.method: radial silhouette (508 of 716 rays kept), mapped to the plane of the cake top through the calibrated camera, robust circle fit; residual SD 0.08 mm
cake_top_diameter_mm.uncertainty: dominated by the cake height (41-53 mm); focal 1400-1442 changes D by < 1 mm

cake_height_mm.method: near-side top rim (y=1015) and base on mat (y=1177) at x=946; camera from mat homography (64 crossings, RMS 0.52 mm); height range spans focal 1500-1850

cyclotron_rear_panel_outer_diameter_mm.method: 8 edge points read at 3x zoom on the left, right and top arcs, mapped to the mat through the calibrated camera (z 0-6 mm), circle fit; residuals within 1.1 mm

img1_red_hose_width_px.method: half-maximum edges on the red channel, 5 parallel profiles per point

img1_scale_mm_per_px.status: PROVISIONAL: single reference (hose_6mm), not yet validated against a second independent reference

open_issues: Absolute scale of the Hasbro product photos rests on the stated 6 mm hose only. It implies an overall front height of about 880 mm, which needs a second, independent check before the general arrangement can be drawn as more than provisional.
Candidate second references: the 262 mm rear panel or 141 mm cake carried into Hasbro image 7 (needs a depth correction), or one tape-measure reading of the pack by an owner.
